title: Level up
one_line: Rays, the new level as a hero number, what it unlocked, CONTINUE.
opens_from: result (if the match crossed a level threshold)

anatomy.spec: Dimmed, gold rays turning (same fx_rays as Result).
The new level as a hero number, 44 pt, white with the ink outline.
Item icons listed for what the new level unlocked (avatar frame tier, multiplier cap increase, etc.).

states: Multi-level jump (rare, e.g. a big NX gain crosses two thresholds) - show the final level reached, list all unlocks combined, do not stack two takeovers
motion: Number counts up from the old level to the new one.
data: Level thresholds and unlocks: a level table, currently implicit - formalize as data so this screen and Profile agree.

assets_needed.name: logo_levelup
assets_needed.prompt: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 6, P1-3: LEVEL UP! logotype, same style as VICTORY!.

do_not: Do not stack two level-up takeovers for a multi-level jump - show one, combined.
Do not show this at the same moment as the Result celebration - it queues after Result closes.
acceptance: Shows exactly once per threshold crossed, queued after Result.
Multi-level jumps combine into one screen.
steps: 1. Preflight - formalize the level/unlock table if it does not exist as data yet.
2. Build the takeover with rays, hero number, unlocks list, CONTINUE.
3. Wire the queue so it shows after Result closes, never simultaneously.
prompt:
